title: feat: add job execution with cgroup integration
body:
## Summary

- Add `Job.Start()` and `Job.Stop()` methods for process lifecycle management with cgroup v2 integration
- Embed `JobState` struct in `Job` for cleaner state management with atomic multi-field reads via `State()` method
- Define sentinel errors (`ErrJobNotFound`, `ErrJobAlreadyStarted`, etc.) for proper error handling
- Use `UseCgroupFD` for atomic cgroup assignment at fork time
- Spawn background `wait()` goroutine that handles process completion and cleanup

 ## Concurrency Fixes                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                           
  ### MemoryBuffer Race Conditions (Fixed)                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                           
 - Lost Wakeup Bug                                                                                                                                           
     - `Reader.Close()` could call `Broadcast()` before `Read()` entered `Wait()`, causing goroutine leaks                                                                                    
     - Fix: New `waitForData()` checks stop condition inside lock before waiting                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - Data Race on Reader.offset                                                                                                                                     
     - `r.offset` was modified without mutex protection                                                                                                                                       
     - Fix: All offset access now protected by `r.mu`  
   
  - Thundering Herd                                                                                                                                              
     - `sync.Cond.Broadcast()` woke ALL readers on every write, causing mutex contention                                                                                                      
     - Fix: Per-reader notification channels - each reader waits on its own channel, no contention on wake  
    
  - Lock Contention During Notification                                                                                                                                             
     - Lock was held while iterating and sending to all reader channels (~1ms for 1000 readers)                                                                                               
     - Fix: Copy channel list under lock, release lock, then send notifications                                                                                                               
      - Result: Lock hold time reduced from ~1ms to ~50μs  
   
  ### Implementation                                                                                                                                                                       
  - Replaced `sync.Cond` with `map[*MemoryBufferReader]chan struct{}`                                                                                                                      
  - Each reader registers/unregisters its notification channel                                                                                                                             
  - `Write()` and `Close()` release lock before sending notifications                                                                                                                      
  - Clean context cancellation via `select` on `notify` + `ctx.Done()`                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  ## Test Plan                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - [x] Run `go test -v -race ./pkg/worker/...` - all 50 tests pass                                                                                                                        
  - [x] Run `go test -v -race -count=100 ./pkg/worker/...` - no flaky races                                                                                                                
  - [ ] Verify cgroup cleanup after job completion                                                                                                                                         
  - [ ] Test job stop with `cgroup.kill` file

title: feat: add cgroup v2 management package
body:
Implement Cgroup struct for managing cgroup v2 lifecycle:
- Create: mkdir + write resource limits (cpu.max, memory.max, io.weight)
- OpenFD/CloseFD: get directory FD for SysProcAttr.CgroupFD
- Kill: write to cgroup.kill for atomic process termination
- Remove: cleanup cgroup directory
- IsEmpty: check cgroup.events for populated status
- Validate: check limits are within valid ranges

Features:
- Rollback on Create failure (removes partial state)
- Limit validation (CPU >= 0, memory >= 0, IOWeight 1-10000)
- 22 tests covering happy and unhappy paths

body:
Comprehensive design covering:
  - gRPC API with mTLS (TLS 1.3, ECDSA P-256)
  - Per-user job isolation with admin superuser access
  - Output streaming using sync.Cond for zero-allocation notifications
  - CLI (worker-cli) and server (worker-server) binaries
  - Kingpin-based CLI with start, stop, status, logs commands

  Includes implementation patterns, goroutine lifecycle management,
  known complexity areas, and integration testing strategy.
